question: In March 2022, who was appointed the Chairman of Air India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**N Chandrasekaran**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• N Chandrasekaran was appointed as the Chairman of Air India in March 2022.
 
• He is also the Chairman of Tata Sons, the holding company and promoter of all Tata Group companies.
 
• Chandrasekaran has been instrumental in driving Tata Group's growth and transformation across various sectors.
 
• He took over as Chairman of Tata Sons in February 2017, and his tenure has been marked by significant strategic initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Air India**

 
 
• Air India is the flag carrier airline of India, headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• It was founded by J. R. D. Tata of Tata Sons in 1932 as Tata Airlines.
 
• After World War II, it became a public limited company and was renamed Air India.
 
• In January 2022, the Tata Group officially took over Air India from the Indian government, making it a private entity once again.
 
 
 
• **Tata Sons**
 
 
• Tata Sons is the holding company of the Tata Group, India's largest and oldest conglomerate.
 
• Founded in 1868 by Jamsetji Tata, the Tata Group operates in over 100 countries across six continents.
 
• Tata Sons is responsible for strategic leadership and management of various Tata companies.
 
• The group operates in diverse sectors such as IT, steel, automotive, consumer goods, telecommunications, and hospitality.
 
 
 
• **N Chandrasekaran**
 
 
• Natarajan Chandrasekaran, commonly known as N Chandrasekaran, is an Indian business executive.
 
• He served as the CEO and Managing Director of Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), India's largest IT services company, before becoming the Chairman of Tata Sons.
 
• Under his leadership, TCS saw significant growth and became one of the top IT services companies globally.
 
• Chandrasekaran is known for his strategic vision, leadership skills, and focus on innovation and customer-centricity.
 
 
 
• **Tata Group's Acquisition of Air India**
 
 
• The Tata Group's acquisition of Air India marked a significant milestone in Indian aviation history.
 
• It was a homecoming for Air India, as the airline was originally founded by the Tata Group.
 
• The acquisition is expected to bring synergies and operational efficiencies to Air India, leveraging Tata Group's expertise in various sectors.
 
• The Tata Group plans to revamp Air India's operations, enhance customer experience, and expand its global footprint.
